task.title: Add images and diagrams
task.shortdesc: Reference image files from topics with <image>. They are published with the release and shown only to readers who can see a topic that uses them.

step.cmd: Put the file in the project, for example in images/.

info.p: SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP are served on the site and embedded in PDFs. For diagrams, prefer SVG with a <title> and <desc> and a solid background, so it reads in both light and dark themes. The diagrams on the overview are hand-written SVG.

step.cmd: Reference it with a path relative to the topic, and always give alternative text.

stepxmp.codeblock: <fig id="fig-architecture"> <title>The hosted platform</title> <image href="../images/architecture.svg" placement="break"> <alt>Diagram: the docs repository sends a push webhook to the web service...</alt> </image> </fig>

info.p: placement="break" puts the image on its own line; without it the image is inline. width and height are passed through. keyref works too, with the key's href naming the file.
A missing file is an error, missing-image. External images (an https: URL or scope="external") are not checked and are not embedded in PDFs.

result.p: On the hosted site, images are served from /_assets/ only when a topic visible to the signed-in reader references them, so guessing a path reveals nothing. Author files, SVG included, are served with a sandboxing Content Security Policy.
